institution.title: Institution review and filing
institution.intro: A frozen form goes to a licensed institution, which accepts or returns it and records the filing. The licence check is a demo, not verification.
institution.registry_empty: No institutions loaded. Nothing real ships with the product.
institution.load_demo_note: Placeholder names and licence numbers. They assert nothing about any real company.
institution.submit_note: The form must be frozen first. Submitting again switches institution and leaves the frozen form untouched.
institution.unknown_option: An institution not in the registry (see what happens)
institution.filing_note: The registration number comes from a human reading the government system. This product never generates one.
institution.creator_view_note: Switch the role to Institution to accept, return, or record a filing.
license.disclaimer: A demo check against local data. It is not licence verification and proves nothing about any real entity.
license.reason.not_in_registry: This institution is not in the registry, so nothing can be checked. Unknown, not approved.
license.reason.capital: Registered capital is below the demo threshold.
institution.load_demo_admin_only: Only an administrator can load the demo registry. Switch the role above to Admin.
